whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Nexus Gym,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.3★ reviews across 268+ ratings in Rukanpura, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for trial sessions.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/nexusgym

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team The Nexus Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym (The Nexus Gym) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and a showcase of your top-rated facility in Rukanpura, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
